name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 82.3 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: Potrebujem 3 karte za jutri zjutraj.
entries.reference: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.

entries.source: Nas je 5, vključno z 2 otrokoma.
entries.reference: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.

entries.source: Moja telefonska številka je 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: Let traja 9 ur in 25 minut.
entries.reference: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.

entries.source: Nas je 4 in imamo 6 kovčkov.
entries.reference: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.

entries.source: Soba 214 je v drugem nadstropju.
entries.reference: Room 214 is on the second floor.

entries.source: Prispel sem 3. oktobra in odhajam 9. oktobra.
entries.reference: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.

entries.source: Ob kateri uri se muzej odpre ob nedeljah?
entries.reference: What time does the museum open on Sundays?

entries.source: Moj vlak odpelje ob 18:45 s perona 7.
entries.reference: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.

entries.source: Zadnji avtobus odpelje ob 23:30 nocoj.
entries.reference: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.

entries.source: Imam rezervacijo ob 20.00 za 2 osebi.
entries.reference: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.

entries.source: Ali se lekarna odpre pred 9. uro zjutraj?
entries.reference: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?

entries.source: Ogled se začne ob 14:15 in traja 3 ure.
entries.reference: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.

entries.source: Zajtrk postrežejo od 6:30 do 10:00.
entries.reference: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.

entries.source: Koliko stane dvoposteljna soba za 3 noči?
entries.reference: How much is a double room for 3 nights?

entries.source: To stane 45 evrov, vključno z davkom.
entries.reference: This costs 45 euros, including tax.

entries.source: Ali obstaja popust za 2 odrasli in 1 otroka?
entries.reference: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?

entries.source: Vozovnica stane 12,50 evra na osebo.
entries.reference: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.

entries.source: Lahko 78 evrov plačam s kartico?
entries.reference: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?

entries.source: Koliko stane avtobus na letališče za 2 osebi?
entries.reference: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?

entries.source: Dnevni meni stane 15 evrov, pijača je vključena.
entries.reference: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.

entries.source: Naslov je Calle Mayor 15, tretje nadstropje.
entries.reference: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.

entries.source: Moj hotel je na Gran Vía 28, blizu podzemne železnice.
entries.reference: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.

entries.source: Veleposlaništvo je na Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Prosim, zapišite naslov: številka 42, stanovanje 5B.
entries.reference: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.

entries.source: Mesto srečanja je Plaza del Sol, vhoda 3.
entries.reference: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.

entries.source: Je to pot do Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Kje je najbližje avtobusno postajališče?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest bus stop?

entries.source: Na semaforju zavijte levo in nato pojdite naravnost 200 metrov.
entries.reference: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.

entries.source: Se da od postaje do hotela priti peš?
entries.reference: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?

entries.source: Katera linija gre na letališče, linija 5 ali linija 8?
entries.reference: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?

entries.source: Oprostite, ali je to sedež 14A?
entries.reference: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?

entries.source: Kako pridem od tod v staro mesto?
entries.reference: How do I get to the old town from here?

entries.source: Muzej je od trga oddaljen približno 15 minut hoje.
entries.reference: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.

entries.source: Prosim, pokličite rešilca, nekdo je nezavesten.
entries.reference: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.

entries.source: Izgubil sem potni list in denarnico.
entries.reference: I have lost my passport and my wallet.

entries.source: Kje je najbližja bolnišnica ali klinika?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?

entries.source: Sem alergičen na arašide; ali ta jed vsebuje arašide?
entries.reference: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?

entries.source: Nekdo mi je ukradel torbo z 200 evri notri.
entries.reference: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.

entries.source: Prosim, pokličite policijo. Zgodila se je nesreča.
entries.reference: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
